Name: Remove Bigfoot (Sasquatch)
Description:
Tiny mod to prevent the bigfoot/sasquatch easter egg from showing up. No more sudden scares!

Thanks BlaDe for info to make this mod possible! [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G-ueFAdEuD8]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G-ueFAdEuD8[/url]﻿

This mod was made on request of someone in the SDV discord server. If you have issues, please report them, but I may not add more the mod on top of this.

[url=https://github.com/6480k/6480-Stardew-Mods/tree/main/%5BCP%5D%20Remove%20Bigfoot]Github[/url]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Remove Bigfoot
Manifest.Description: Removes the bigfoot or sasquatch easter egg from 1.6.9+.
